entities.summary: Mohamed Benhima was the Prime Minister of Morocco, serving from 7 July 1967 to 7 October 1969. He was born in Safi (Asfi) to Taïbi Benhima and Rkia Benhida. He was also Minister of Education and Minister of the Interior.
